[[File:McKenzie.png|thumb|250px|McKenzie]] '''McKenzie''' (Japanese: '''イサミ''' ''Isami'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP201|Doin' What Comes Natu-rally]]''. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} first encountered McKenzie while he was trying to train his {{p|Natu}}, [[nickname]]d Naughty. When they asked what he was doing, he got scared and ran away. They soon encountered him again at a fair where Pokémon displayed their talents. [[McKenzie's father]] asked McKenzie and Naughty to look into {{an|Misty}}'s future. However, he did the routine all wrong due to stage fright. Ash and the gang decided to help him, and Misty advised that McKenzie should wear a mask so that the audience wouldn't see his face. McKenzie was in the middle of trying out his new act when {{TRT}} attacked the fair and stole Naughty, along with some other Pokémon. He eventually got Naughty back, and after that, he used it to battle [[Jessie]] and her {{TP|Jessie|Arbok}}. All the while, an audience was watching him, but McKenzie wasn't fazed at all by it. McKenzie told Naughty to use {{m|Confuse Ray}} on Arbok, making it confused and go after Team Rocket as a result. Ash then ordered {{AP|Pikachu}} to use {{m|Thunderbolt}}, which sent Team Rocket blasting off. McKenzie was then asked by a schoolteacher if he could put on a show for the children. He agreed and did his performance perfectly. He even felt comfortable enough to take off his mask. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=McKenzie |nick=Naughty |pkmn=Natu |type1=Psychic |type2=Flying |img=McKenzie Naughty.png |epnum=EP201 |epname=Doin' What Comes Natu-rally |desc=McKenzie has a {{p|Natu}} [[nickname]]d '''Naughty''' (Japanese: '''ナイティ''' ''Naiti''). It tried to tell fortunes at a fair like [[McKenzie's father]]'s Natu, but always messed up because McKenzie was suffering from stage fright. {{an|Misty}} tried to help by giving Naughty's Trainer a {{p|Wooper}} mask, so that his stage fright would go over. Everything ran smoothly, until Naughty tried to use its psychic powers while they were not strong enough yet. Later, Naughty sensed {{TRT}} coming. They indeed came and they stole Naughty, including loads of other Pokémon. [[Ash's Bayleef]] was later able to free all the Pokémon, though Naughty was nowhere to be seen. They then found {{TRT}} still had it. Naughty used its {{m|Confuse Ray}} on {{TP|Jessie|Arbok}} and eventually helped to send Team Rocket blasting off. McKenzie thought that now Naughty would be powerful enough to tell the future of someone. It tried on a child and this time, it succeeded. Naughty's known moves are {{m|Peck}}, {{m|Teleport}}, {{m|Future Sight}}, and {{m|Confuse Ray}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{psychic color}}|bordercolor={{flying color light}} |ja=斎賀みつき ''[[Mitsuki Saiga]]'' |en=[[Kayzie Rogers]] |ar=ماغي بو غصن ''Maguy Bou Ghosn'' |cs=Jakub Nerger |it=Federica Valenti |pt_br=Francisco Freitas |es_la=Liliana Barba |es_eu=Chelo Vivares |pl=Joanna Domańska}}
